# simple_get_object — smallest end-to-end spec: one GET, no auth, no pagination
# Boots the simple_get_object scenario, runs one drain, and asserts the
# events JSONL and redacted trace JSONL match the golden.
# The spec is loaded live from the embedded template.

exec skopos template show -o spec.yml simple_get_object
replace spec.yml http://localhost:9999 $URL
exec skopos run -i spec.yml --once --trace trace.jsonl --out events.jsonl
normalize trace.jsonl
cmp trace.jsonl want_trace.jsonl
cmp events.jsonl want_events.jsonl

-- want_trace.jsonl --
{"elapsed":"<scrubbed>","iteration":1,"method":"GET","request_headers":{"Accept":"application/json, application/x-ndjson;q=0.9, */*;q=0.1"},"response_body":"body 67 bytes, object-like","started_at":"<scrubbed>","status":200,"url":"$URL_HOST/simple_get_object/status"}
-- want_events.jsonl --
{"id":"evt-000001","seq_num":1,"timestamp":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"}
